regions.name: Mare Tranquillitatis (Apollo 11)
regions.summary: Plain of titanium-rich mare basalts covered by several metres of mature regolith.

regions.name: Hadley-Apennine (Apollo 15)
regions.summary: Edge of a basaltic mare next to a sinuous lava channel (Rima Hadley) and the Apennine mountain front.

regions.name: Descartes Highlands (Apollo 16)
regions.summary: Feldspathic highlands: anorthositic impact breccias, with no mare basalts.

regions.name: Taurus-Littrow Valley (Apollo 17)
regions.summary: Valley between highland massifs, filled with basalts and with pyroclastic deposits (orange glass).

regions.name: Shackleton crater (south pole, Artemis region)
regions.summary: Polar crater with a permanently shadowed interior and rims in near-continuous sunlight; a candidate to hold volatiles.

regions.name: Marius Hills (lava tube skylight)
regions.summary: Volcanic complex with domes and cones on mare basalts; hosts a skylight of a possible lava tube.

regions.name: Aristarchus Plateau
regions.summary: Volcanic plateau with the Moon's largest regional pyroclastic deposit and the sinuous channel Vallis Schröteri.

regions.name: Von Kármán crater, South Pole-Aitken basin (Chang'E-4)
regions.summary: Basalt-filled crater floor inside the largest lunar impact basin, on the far side.

regions.name: Gale crater (Curiosity)
regions.summary: Crater with clay-rich fluvio-lacustrine sediments, an upper sulfate unit and an active basaltic dune field.

regions.name: Jezero crater (Perseverance)
regions.summary: Palaeolake with a well-preserved delta, a floor of aqueously altered igneous rocks and carbonate-bearing units.

regions.name: Meridiani Planum (Opportunity)
regions.summary: Plain of sulfate-rich sandstones with hematite spherules and jarosite, formed in acidic, saline environments.

regions.name: Gusev crater / Columbia Hills (Spirit)
regions.summary: Basaltic lava plains and hills with hydrothermal opaline silica deposits and carbonate-bearing outcrops.

regions.name: Elysium Planitia (InSight)
regions.summary: Very flat volcanic plain with a few metres of sandy regolith over basaltic flows.

regions.name: Vastitas Borealis (Phoenix)
regions.summary: Polar plain with polygonal ground and water ice a few centimetres deep; soil with perchlorates and carbonate.

regions.name: Ares Vallis, Chryse Planitia (Mars Pathfinder)
regions.summary: Mouth of a catastrophic flood channel: a plain of boulders deposited by megafloods.

regions.name: Arsia Mons (Tharsis)
regions.summary: Giant shield volcano; possible volcanic cave skylights have been identified on its flanks.

regions.name: Melas Chasma (Valles Marineris)
regions.summary: Central section of the canyon system, with walls several kilometres high and sulfate-rich layered deposits.

regions.name: Oxia Planum (Rosalind Franklin rover site)
regions.summary: Ancient plain with extensive Fe/Mg-rich clay deposits and remnants of a fluvio-deltaic system.

regions.name: Olympia Undae (north polar erg)
regions.summary: Circumpolar dune sea of basaltic sand and gypsum, seasonally stabilised by frost and ice.

rationale.es: Lago dentro de una caldera volcánica a unos 4.570 m, con radiación UV muy alta, aire delgado y aguas muy salinas y ricas en arsénico. Tiene tapetes microbianos de extremófilos y se estudia como análogo de lagos marcianos antiguos y de la búsqueda de vida.
rationale.en: A lake inside a volcanic caldera at about 4,570 m, with very high UV radiation, thin air and very saline, arsenic-rich water. It hosts mats of extremophile microbes and is studied as an analog of ancient Martian lakes and of the search for life.

note.es: La propuesta lo ubicaba en Mendoza. El lago de los extremófilos estudiado a esa altitud está en la caldera del Galán, en Catamarca; la Laguna del Diamante de Mendoza está en la caldera del Maipo, a unos 3.300 m. Se usa la ubicación de Catamarca.
note.en: The proposal placed it in Mendoza. The extremophile lake studied at that altitude is in the Galán caldera, in Catamarca; Mendoza's Laguna del Diamante is in the Maipo caldera, at about 3,300 m. The Catamarca location is used.

text.en: Red biofilms of haloarchaea in a saline, arsenic-rich lake (Rascovan et al., 2016).
text.es: Biopelículas rojas de haloarqueas en un lago salino con arsénico (Rascovan et al., 2016).

text.en: Water of extreme salinity, as stated in the team's proposal.
text.es: Aguas de salinidad extrema, según la propuesta del equipo.

references.title: Rascovan et al. (2016), Metagenomic study of red biofilms from Diamante Lake reveals ancient arsenic bioenergetics in haloarchaea. The ISME Journal

rationale.es: Coladas de basalto de inundación de la Formación Arapey (Salto, Artigas, Paysandú), parecidas a los mares lunares y a las llanuras volcánicas de Marte. Las aguas termales de Arapey y Daymán vienen del Acuífero Guaraní, agua subterránea profunda y antigua, propuesta como análogo de la hipótesis de agua en el subsuelo marciano.
rationale.en: Flood-basalt flows of the Arapey Formation (Salto, Artigas, Paysandú), similar to the lunar maria and to the volcanic plains of Mars. The thermal waters of Arapey and Daymán come from the Guaraní Aquifer, deep and ancient groundwater, proposed as an analog of the hypothesis of water in the Martian subsurface.

note.es: Las termas son agua del acuífero que sale caliente por la profundidad de los pozos; no se registran acá depósitos minerales hidrotermales, así que no se le asigna esa cualidad.
note.en: The thermal baths are aquifer water that comes out warm because of the depth of the wells; no hydrothermal mineral deposits are recorded here, so that quality is not assigned.

text.en: Flood-basalt flows, as stated in the team's proposal.
text.es: Coladas de basalto de inundación, según la propuesta del equipo.

rationale.es: Antiguos desiertos de dunas fosilizados; es el mismo sistema de areniscas que contiene al Acuífero Guaraní. Se propone como análogo de la arenisca eólica marciana.
rationale.en: Ancient dune deserts turned to stone; the same sandstone system that holds the Guaraní Aquifer. Proposed as an analog of Martian aeolian sandstone.

text.en: Sandstone from ancient dunes, a layered sedimentary rock, as stated in the team's proposal.
text.es: Arenisca de dunas antiguas, una roca sedimentaria en capas, según la propuesta del equipo.

rationale.es: La mayor costra de sal del mundo, resto de antiguos lagos del Altiplano, a gran altitud y con alta radiación UV. Se propone como análogo de cuencas evaporíticas marcianas.
rationale.en: The world's largest salt crust, the remains of ancient Altiplano lakes, at high altitude and with strong UV radiation. Proposed as an analog of Martian evaporite basins.

text.en: Salt crust of an evaporite basin, as stated in the team's proposal.
text.es: Costra de sal de una cuenca evaporítica, según la propuesta del equipo.
